title: Organizations
intro: Run BeliefAtlas questions on your own site, app, point of sale or ad space. People still answer on BeliefAtlas with their own account, and you only ever see totals for groups big enough that no one can be picked out.
notice: Every card, embed and export shows the Unofficial notice: BeliefAtlas results are opinions, not official or binding.
none: You're not in any organization yet.

create.title: Start an organization
create.name: Organization name
create.slug: Short name for links (lowercase letters, digits and dashes)
create.country: Country where it's based (two-letter code, like US)
create.note: Every organization is checked against the US, UN, EU and UK sanctions lists before anything it makes goes live. Organizations from some places can't be accepted at all.

status.title: Status
status.serving: Live: placements that are switched on can show questions.
status.screening: Waiting for the sanctions check. Nothing goes live until a person at BeliefAtlas approves it.
status.refused: This organization can't be accepted, so nothing it makes goes live.
status.suspended: Suspended by BeliefAtlas, so nothing it makes goes live.
status.test: Test organization: it never goes live in production.

plan.title: Plan
plan.current: {plan, select, pro {Pro} business {Business} other {Free}} plan: up to {placements} placements, {members} people and {keys} server keys.
plan.relay: {relay, select, yes {Includes sending votes from your server.} other {Doesn't include sending votes from your server.}}
plan.lapsed: The paid plan isn't active ({status}), so the Free limits apply.
plan.choose: Change to {plan, select, pro {Pro} business {Business} other {Free}}
plan.off: Paid plans aren't open yet. BeliefAtlas can set a plan for you by hand.

members.title: People
members.intro: People need a BeliefAtlas account first. Add them by username.

placements.title: Placements
placements.intro: A placement is one spot where your questions show up, like a page, a checkout screen or an ad slot.
placements.label: Name
placements.kinds: {kind, select, site {Website} app {App} cms {CMS} pos {Point of sale} ad {Ad space} kiosk {Kiosk} other {Other}}
placements.origins: Websites allowed to show it (one per line, like https://shop.example)
placements.questions: Question numbers or links (leave empty for any question)
placements.attest: This spot isn't aimed at children, and we won't use it to reach anyone under 18.
placements.tooFew: Question {id}: not enough answers yet to show.
placements.split: Question {id}: {total} answers. True {t}%, False {f}%, Don't know {u}%.

keys.title: Server keys
keys.intro: A key lets your server send votes or read results. Keep it on your server only: BeliefAtlas refuses a key sent from a browser.
keys.off: Server keys aren't switched on yet.
keys.label: What it's for
keys.shownOnce: Copy this key now. It won't be shown again.

saved: {what, select, created {Organization started.} member {Saved.} placement {Placement saved.} key {Key revoked.} plan {Plan updated.} other {Saved.}}

errors.slug: That short name won't work. Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
errors.name: Give the organization a name.
errors.country: BeliefAtlas can't accept an organization from that country, or the code isn't valid.
errors.too_many_orgs: You've started as many organizations as one account can.
errors.not_admin: Only an admin of this organization can do that.
errors.no_user: There's no BeliefAtlas account with that username.
errors.plan_members: Your plan's limit on people is reached.
errors.last_admin: An organization needs at least one admin.
errors.plan_placements: Your plan's limit on placements is reached.
errors.label: Give it a name, and for a key choose what it can do.
errors.attest: Placements can't be aimed at children, so this box needs ticking.
errors.questions: One of those questions doesn't exist or isn't open.
errors.origins: One of those websites isn't a valid https address.
errors.plan_keys: Your plan's limit on server keys is reached.
errors.plan_relay: Your plan doesn't include sending votes from your server.
errors.not_serving: That opens once the organization has been approved.
